description: Source code defining an abstract syntax tree (AST) for constructing and manipulating column expressions in Apache Spark SQL. Includes classes and traits for literals, attributes, functions, window functions, subqueries, and various expression nodes.

classes.name: ColumnNode
classes.description: Trait representing an abstract syntax tree node for column expressions.

classes.name: Literal
classes.description: Represents a literal value in a column expression.

classes.name: UnresolvedAttribute
classes.description: Represents a reference to an attribute/column that is unresolved.

classes.name: UnresolvedStar
classes.description: Represents a reference to all columns in a namespace or global scope.

classes.name: UnresolvedFunction
classes.description: Represents a function call (built-in, UDF, or registered function).

classes.name: SqlExpression
classes.description: Represents a raw SQL expression.

classes.name: Alias
classes.description: Names a column and optionally modifies its metadata.

classes.name: Cast
classes.description: Casts a column to a different data type, with optional evaluation mode.

classes.name: UnresolvedRegex
classes.description: References columns matching a regex pattern.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: Specifies sorting order for columns.

classes.name: Window
classes.description: Represents a window function application.

classes.name: WindowSpec
classes.description: Defines window partitioning, ordering, and framing.

classes.name: WindowFrame
classes.description: Defines the frame boundaries for window functions.

classes.name: LambdaFunction
classes.description: Represents a lambda function with arguments.

classes.name: UnresolvedNamedLambdaVariable
classes.description: Variable used within a lambda function.

classes.name: UnresolvedExtractValue
classes.description: Extracts a value from a complex type (struct, map, array).

classes.name: UpdateFields
classes.description: Updates or drops a field in a struct.

classes.name: CaseWhenOtherwise
classes.description: Represents conditional branching logic.

classes.name: InvokeInlineUserDefinedFunction
classes.description: Invokes a user-defined function inline.

classes.name: LazyExpression
classes.description: Marker for lazy analysis in Spark.

classes.name: SubqueryExpression
classes.description: Represents a subquery expression.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the node, stripping dataset-specific metadata.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Returns a SQL-like string representation of the node.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns child nodes of the expression.

methods.name: argumentsToSql
methods.description: Converts a sequence of argument nodes to a SQL string.

methods.name: textArgumentsToSql
methods.description: Converts string parts to a parenthesized SQL argument list.

methods.name: elementsToSql
methods.description: Converts a sequence of nodes to a comma-separated SQL string with optional prefix.

methods.name: optionToSql
methods.description: Converts an optional node to its SQL string or empty.
